meta.source: Mac mini hand-off 15 Nov 2026 (data/handoff_macmini_1115 + ~/Downloads/adinfinitium_handoff_core.tar.gz records) and team PC results (results_pc/extracted); every row carries its own source. All rover, lander and planner numbers are simulation results; hazard/light/terrain truth is derived from NASA LOLA 5 m data.
meta.built: 2026-11-15 by the benchmark lead; benchmarks only, nothing trained, tuned or re-flown; full tables and failure analysis in data/handoff_macmini_1115/BENCHMARKS.md
meta.note: Paired comparisons: every row of a family is scored on the same windows / missions / worlds. ci95 = 95% interval (window or world bootstrap, Wilson for lander rates, site bootstrap for rover). 'ours' marks project models. Best value per column is highlighted automatically, including trivial baselines.

families.name: Hazard
families.lede: Which 5 m ground cells are too steep to land on (NASA LOLA slope of 12 degrees or more).
families.test_set: Six fresh sites never used for training or selection (DM1, LM7, NPA, NPB, NPC, NPD; one 1024x1024 window each) and held-out Site23 (13 windows) + Site42 (6 windows). All pixels; truth is NASA's 5 m slope map (about 90% of it interpolated, see notes).
families.source: archive ./macbook/records/weak_flags/hazard.json (per-window confusion counts, frozen checkpoint hazard_unet_big cd6c4383eb; reproduces frozen_run/runs/hazard/eval.json exactly on Site23/42); pooled + window-bootstrap CIs derived for this table

metrics.label: F1, fresh sites
metrics.definition: Harmonic mean of precision and recall for unsafe pixels, confusion counts pooled over the six fresh-site windows.

metrics.label: F1, Site23+42
metrics.definition: Same F1, pooled over the 19 held-out windows of Site23 and Site42 (73% of their pixels are unsafe).

metrics.label: Recall, fresh
metrics.definition: Share of truly unsafe pixels on the fresh sites that the method flags as unsafe.

metrics.label: False alarms, fresh
metrics.definition: Share of truly safe pixels on the fresh sites wrongly flagged as unsafe.

rows.name: Constant: flag everything unsafe

families.name: Light
families.lede: The skyline (horizon height in 360 directions) of each cell, which decides when it sees the Sun and the Earth.
families.test_set: Held-out Site23 (13 windows) + Site42 (6 windows), 1,000 sampled cells per window; fresh sites DM1, LM7, NPA-NPD (1 window each, 1,000 cells). Truth = exact ray-cast of the 5 m LOLA grid (rays cut at 1,280 m).
families.source: frozen_run/runs/light/eval.json (per-window values, TEST role) and archive ./macbook/records/weak_flags/light.json (fresh_sites; 6,000-step candidate); means over windows with window-bootstrap CIs derived for this table

metrics.label: Skyline error, Site23+42
metrics.definition: Mean absolute error of the predicted horizon elevation over all 360 directions, averaged over the 19 held-out windows.

metrics.label: Skyline error, fresh
metrics.definition: Same error averaged over the six fresh-site windows.

metrics.label: Sunlit-hours error
metrics.definition: Mean absolute error in sunlit hours per cell over the simulated period, averaged over the 19 held-out windows.

metrics.label: Runtime per window
metrics.definition: Wall-clock seconds to produce 1,000 cells on the Mac mini (MPS), mean over the 19 held-out windows.

families.name: Terrain
families.lede: Height filled in between the laser points (hide half the laser returns, predict them from the rest).
families.test_set: Hide-and-check on real LOLA laser pixels: 96 patches per window, half the laser pixels hidden. Held-out Site23 (13 windows) + Site42 (6 windows); fresh sites DM1, LM7, NPA-NPD. Settings of every classical method chosen on Site11 only.

metrics.label: 90% band coverage

metrics.label: Band width

families.name: Pilot
families.lede: Flying the final descent to a safe touchdown, with engine-outs, navigation drift and blind cameras injected.
families.test_set: Paired fixed-seed missions (same missions for both). Unseen maps for the pilot: Site42, Shoemaker, DM2 (normal and 3x harsh failure rates). Final exam: Site23, flown once on 15 Nov 14:27 and never again.

metrics.label: Landing success, unseen
metrics.definition: Share of the 2,304 paired missions on the three unseen maps that touch down within speed, tilt and slope limits (normal failure rates).

metrics.label: Success, harsh
metrics.definition: Same missions with engine-out, nav-drift and blind-camera rates tripled.

metrics.label: Success, Site23 exam
metrics.definition: Share of the 1,024 paired Site23 final-exam missions landed (normal rates; flown once).

metrics.label: Success after engine-out
metrics.definition: Success on the 243 unseen-map normal-rate missions that had an injected engine failure.

rows.name: Lander pilot (ours, 14,842,567 params; residual on classic)
rows.n: 2,304 paired missions per condition on 3 unseen maps (768 per map); 1,024 paired missions on Site23; engine-out subset n = 243
rows.source: data/handoff_macmini_1115/lander_mini/runs/lander/benchmark.json (identical to repo runs/lander/benchmark.json and to the mini's replication) and benchmark_site23_final.json; engine-out and miss/fuel pooled over maps for this table
rows.note: Pilot minus classic: +0.74 pts [+0.16, +1.32], exact McNemar p = 0.0186 (32 vs 15 discordant) on unseen normal; harsh +0.61 pts, p = 0.18; Site23 exam +0.00 (11 vs 11), harsh -0.20, p = 0.87. Whole unseen gain is from Site42.

families.name: Planner
families.lede: Choosing the landing cell and hour where the whole mission (land, reach ice edge, return) most likely succeeds.
families.test_set: Held-out Site23, 7 dates (worlds), 96 candidate (cell, hour) per world. Label = simulated p(mission) from 32 lander-twin + rover-environment missions per candidate. Planner trained on Site01/06/07/20 only. Site42 has no label files.
families.source: results_pc/extracted/runs/planner/eval.json (team PC, 14 Nov 23:54) + per-world re-derivation from data/planner/*.npz and data/models/planner_*.pt (sha256 identical to results_pc)

metrics.label: Chosen-candidate success
metrics.definition: Simulated mission success of the top-ranked candidate, averaged over the 7 test worlds (best possible: 42.4%).

metrics.label: Regret
metrics.definition: Success of the best candidate in the world minus success of the chosen one, in percentage points, averaged over worlds.

metrics.label: Top-1 hit rate
metrics.definition: Share of the 7 worlds where the chosen candidate is (tied for) the best one.

metrics.label: Brier score
metrics.definition: Mean squared error of the predicted p(mission) against the simulated label over all 672 candidates (calibration; only for models that predict a probability).

families.name: Rover
families.lede: Driving from the lander to a dark shadow-edge target and back before the battery or the light runs out.
families.test_set: Four untouched sites LM2, LM3, LM4, LM5 (never used before this one evaluation), 4 dates each, 512 rovers per world; kinematic simulation, one decision per hour, 300 h episodes. CIs from resampling sites (only 4 neighbouring sites: rough).
families.source: archive ./macbook/records/rover_v31/tables.md and eval.json (rover v3.1 final evaluation, commit 48b459c)

metrics.label: Returned (strict)
metrics.definition: Share of rovers that reach the target and return within 20 m of the lander without the battery ever going empty.

metrics.label: Lost (strict)
metrics.definition: Share of rovers whose battery is empty at the end of any hour, anywhere (including while parked at the lander).

metrics.label: Returned (lenient)
metrics.definition: The simulator's own rule: an empty battery within 20 m of the lander is forgiven.

metrics.label: Reached target
metrics.definition: Share of rovers that got to the shadow-edge target (dark and cold, not confirmed ice), whether or not they came back.

not_benchmarked.why: No swarm or TensorNEAT training run exists in the hand-off or the repo (no generation_*.json anywhere); website/assets/data/neat_training.json is sample data. Only a throughput/smoke check (scripts.bench_swarm) exists.
Not a model to rank; reported as gate outcomes in BENCHMARKS.md (pilot 0 of 7 accepted, planner 1 of 5, rover v3 9 of 72, v3.1 9 of 36 + 0 of 8).
Never scored there; scoring now would need new model runs on sites whose cleanliness is undocumented and is outside a benchmarks-only brief.

not_benchmarked.family: Lander vs any baseline other than classic guidance
not_benchmarked.why: Only classic ZEM/ZEV was flown on the paired missions; Site23 may never be flown again and the unseen maps are benchmark-only and already looked at.
